title: I got lucid in a mall world dream and tried to kidnap a dream character
content: I was in a dream last night with about a two dozen other people in a very large open atrium type of space when I gained lucidity. It was like a giant mall atrium with retail stores all around the lower level, water fountain in the middle and very tall glass skylight ceiling. After I got lucid, I paused for a few moments to reaffirm I was dreaming and lucid and to establish confidence in the scene. This type of lucidity felt different because I was still going through the motions of whatever role I was playing in the scene as if I was not lucid. Once I broke character role, I decided to pick up the closest dream character and started carrying this person away. Not sure why I did that or what the plan was but all of the sudden all the other dream characters gasped in shock with wide eyes and hands over open mouths. Almost like I was committing a real crime right there in front of them. One character chased after me and I put down the person I was carrying and I got into a small shoving match with this other character. He was very upset that not only did I break role in the scene, but I was also trying to kidnap one of the other actors. This freaked me out so I turned and started walking away again and every step I took was harder than the last like some invisible force was holding me back. I struggled to take 10 more steps until I was paralyzed in a standing position unable to move anything. Then I woke up in my bed with a sharp sensation in the middle of my head that faded over a few minutes. This was the first time I had dream characters respond negatively to my lucidity, normally dream characters just bend and mold to whatever actions I want without much independent thought or opposing reactions from them. But this was not the first time I was held back or pulled out of a dream by this invisible force. I sometimes ponder that some dreams are actually shared dreams with other sleeping souls, almost like sometimes when we sleep we tap into this higher realm and join up with others in our dream state and sometimes we just wander around but also sometimes we are used like pawns playing character roles in a play for entertainment. I can't say for sure, but the atrium space was very tall, I didn't look up but their could've been observation balconies overhead for an audience to watch if there was one. I felt there were a lot of eyes on me. I'm starting to think this whole mall world concept could be an actual real place in a different realm that we can be accessed while sleeping.
